$description: TURBINE design tokens. W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft format ($value / $type). Exported from the Figma variables of the TURBINE file. Source of truth for every value here is docs/CANON.md sections 4, 5 and 6.

meta.$description: Informational group. Not a token set: build tools should exclude `meta` from CSS/JS output. Entries carry $type "string", which is not a DTCG type — it marks them as non-tokens.

project.$description: Fictional electronic music festival. Teaching material for the WaysConf 2026 masterclass 'Build an AI that checks and fixes its own work'.

source.$description: These tokens are exported from the Figma variables of the TURBINE file. Figma is upstream: edit variables there, re-export, and let the design-token diff check fail the loop if this file and the built site drift apart.

canon.$description: Every colour, family, weight, size, spacing step, radius and breakpoint below is fixed by CANON. If a value here disagrees with CANON, CANON wins.

format.$value: W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft, $value / $type

theme.$description: CANON section 4: dark theme is the only theme. There is no light palette and no theme switcher.

contrast.$description: Computed WCAG 2.x contrast matrix for this palette, including the deliberate failures described in CANON section 8.

notTokenised.$value: line-height, opacity, motion duration, easing, z-index
notTokenised.$description: CANON does not fix these, so they are deliberately absent rather than invented. Add them upstream in Figma first, then re-export.

extension.$description: The `shadow` group is the one group with no CANON counterpart. It is an implementation extension, derived from the dark palette, and is excluded from the design-token diff check.

color.$description: CANON section 4. Thirteen colours, dark theme only. The palette is built so that a careless implementation will fail contrast; see CANON section 8 and CONTRAST.md.

base.$description: Page background. Also the correct ink on accent and state fills.

subtle.$description: Hairlines, card borders. Decorative only: 1.45:1 on bg.base, below the 3:1 non-text bar, so it must never be the sole indicator of a control.

strong.$description: Focus ring base, dividers. 1.98:1 on bg.base: usable as an offset or underlay, never as the visible focus indicator on its own. See CONTRAST.md.

secondary.$description: Supporting copy. The correct choice wherever a muted grey is wanted.

muted.$description: Trap. Legal and footer text only, never body copy. 4.07:1 on bg.base, under the 4.5:1 normal-text bar. CANON section 8.

on-accent.$description: Alias of bg.base. CANON section 4 fixes dark ink, not white, as the text colour on accent.sodium and on every other accent or state fill.

sodium.$description: Primary accent, sodium lamp orange, CTAs. Pair with text.on-accent, never with white.

typography.$description: CANON section 5. Three Google Fonts families and an eleven-step rem scale.

display.$description: Space Grotesk, Google Fonts. Weights 500 and 700. Display sizes carry letterSpacing.display; the wordmark carries letterSpacing.wordmark.

mono.$description: JetBrains Mono, Google Fonts. Weights 400 and 700.

normal.$description: Body copy and anything set in Inter or JetBrains Mono.

display.$description: Display sizes set in Space Grotesk.

wordmark.$description: The TURBINE wordmark only. All caps. Never rendered as 'Turbine Festival'.

spacing.$description: CANON section 6, in px: 4 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 48 · 64 · 96 · 128. Keys are multiples of the 4px base unit, so spacing.6 is 24px.

pill.$description: Fully rounded ends. Used for genre tags and the ticket badges.

breakpoint.$description: CANON section 6. These three widths are the only ones screenshotted and diffed by the validation step.

tablet.$description: The nav collapses to a hamburger below this width; the programme table stacks below it.

shadow.$description: Implementation extension. CANON sections 4 to 6 do not fix elevation, so these three steps are derived from the dark palette rather than exported from Figma, and the design-token diff check ignores this group. On a near-black ground a shadow reads as absence of light, so each step is plain black at low alpha with a long, soft spread.

sm.$description: Resting cards and the sticky nav once it has scrolled.

md.$description: Hovered lineup cards, the open FAQ panel, the mobile nav sheet.

lg.$description: The highlighted Full Pass ticket card, lifted clear of the grid.
